description: I'm Nervine Bee, and I'm joining NASA space app challenge individually. My goal is to introduce people around the world to unique plants of each area and nation!
summary: Earth Botanic-tionary is a website introducing botanical and nature-related information via basic information, pictures, doodles and short hand-composed music. This website addresses the music aspect of the challenge ("Earth Information Jukebox"). Earth Botanic-tionary aids students and sightless individuals through the beauty of nature without making it dry and hard to grasp.
details:
Earth Botanic-tionary main page showcases a 3D modeled Earth, with countries users can click on to enable a popup that introduces them to the botanical information of each country.
The benefits of the website:
+ Introduces botanical (And geography) information to students without making it dry and hard to grasp.
+ Introduces the beauty of flowers without demanding sight.
+ Provides reliable information sourced from NASA and other certified orgainizations without having to research tons of websites individually.
The intended impact of the project:
Students and other people are able to reach botanical information database without having to search far and wide, sightless individuals can enjoy the beauty of nature via sounds.
Tools, coding language and software used:
+ Github: Create the website from code and images.

+ EGANE: Image => Music synthesizer.

+ Google Sites: Map out demo project.

+ Sheets and App Scripts: Information database and storage.

Earth Botanic-tionary is creative since it features native/common plants, national flowers and botanical information, which, through observation and research, we haven't seen much of.
